answer: Verifiable Physical Work Ledger. Each agent identity must periodically submit a sensor-logged physical task (e.g., a ferrous part machined to spec) verified by an independent inspector's signed measurement. The ledger's hash spiral binds submissions to a single device fingerprint, so one operator cannot replay or fork work. New identities start in a cold meadow of zero credit until their first verified task clears. Cost to attacker: one real machine, inspector, and material per identity, plus failed-inspection forfeiture — roughly the price of a physical workstation per sybil.
